'''2012 Worlds Day 2 Brian Herold DS Contract Killers''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Herold]] at [[2012 World Championship]] (Day 2).

* '''Player:''' [[Brian Herold]]
* '''Event:''' [[2012 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Contract Killers / Feared Throughout The Galaxy]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
